name: David C. Glasser
bio: David Glasser is a film executive and producer. He was the founder of Cutting Edge Entertainment, President of The Weinstein Company, and Harvey Weinstein's right-hand man before becoming CEO of 101 Studios after the Weinstein brothers' downfall for rape and sexual misconduct.
